literature_notes: Every insertion in the ledger is intracellular. L1–L3 (PMC6070948) describe a TSmod FRET sensor inserted between the IA and ICS domains of the DSG2 cytoplasmic tail, pinned by the paper to G733/A734 in the paper's numbering. Python search of the canonical sequence places the nearest GA junction in that region at G734/A735 (canonical), a 1-residue offset consistent with a minor isoform or numbering convention difference; both positions fall squarely in the intracellular domain (residues 635–1118). L4–L7 (PMC12259045, PMC12912264) describe a C-terminal EGFP fusion via pEGFP-N1, placing the tag after residue 1118, also intracellular. No ledger line reports any tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon hit, or domain insertion on the extracellular face (residues 24–614) of full-length, membrane-anchored DSG2. Zero surface sites is therefore the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: TSmod FRET sensor inserted between G733 and A734 (paper numbering; canonical G734/A735) in the cytoplasmic tail between the IA and ICS domains; fully intracellular, not a surface tag site.

C-terminal EGFP fusion via pEGFP-N1 appended after the last residue (S1118) of the intracellular tail; confirmed to localise to cell–cell contacts by FRAP (L6/L7), but the tag itself faces the cytoplasm.
